dedupe_keys.name: police recorded injury road traffic collision statistics northern ireland psni

description: The Police Service of Northern Ireland publishes yearly statistics on injury road traffic collisions reported to the police. Each year's release contains a collision file, a casualty file and a vehicle file as CSV with a data guide, collected under the Department for Transport's STATS20 guidance so that they are comparable with the STATS19 statistics for Great Britain; collisions with damage only or without injuries are excluded. Coverage is national for Northern Ireland, with releases on OpenDataNI for each year from 2021 to 2025. The data are free under the Open Government Licence. Caveats: only collisions reported to the police and involving injury are included, and each year is a separate release. The records support road safety analysis of the network, exposure studies of vulnerable users on particular road types and calibration of safety performance models. They complement the GB STATS19 road safety data catalogued here.
name: Police recorded injury road traffic collision statistics, Northern Ireland (PSNI)
provider: Police Service of Northern Ireland (PSNI), via OpenDataNI
